transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Um, I came in because... well, ever since I tried to turn my art into an actual freelance business, I've been having a really hard time. I just keep getting so wound up over things like invoices and client messages. It gets to be too much, so I end up avoiding them, and then it just builds up until I'm sitting at my kitchen table crying. It's gotten to the point where I'm even forgetting to do normal stuff, like paying my own bills.
Besides your freelance business, do you also find yourself worrying excessively about many other parts of your life?

Um, no, not really. It's honestly just the freelance stuff. I mean, I don't really find myself worrying about much else. Before I started trying to do this business, things were pretty okay. It's just... this specific thing that really seems to set me off.
In response to the freelance-business stress, have you been feeling persistently down or depressed?

No, I wouldn't really say I feel depressed. I mean, I get upset and cry when I'm overwhelmed by all the business stuff, like I mentioned, but it's not like a constant sadness. When I'm not thinking about the freelance work or I'm just doing other things, my mood is mostly fine. So, no, I don't think I feel persistently down.
When did these anxiety symptoms first begin in relation to starting your freelance business?

Um, I'd say I started getting this overwhelmed and avoidant about a month after I took on a community arts contract. That was when I really tried to make the business more formal, instead of just doing it for fun. So yeah, about a month after that is when it all started getting hard.
How long have you been experiencing this anxiety and feeling overwhelmed by the freelance business?
Um, it's been going on for about a month now. Like I was just saying, it really started right around the time I began shifting my art into a more formal freelance business.
